title: Swiss Regulator Ends Proceedings Against Julius Baer
summary:
Julius Baer has applied for permission to restart share buybacks after Swiss regulator Finma concluded its enforcement procedure against the wealth manager, removing a long-standing overhang that has weighed on the stock. Juilius Baer came under scrutiny following steep losses from dealings with Austrian property tycoon Rene Benko. Bloomberg's Tom Metcalf explains.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Angola Raises $224 Million From Standard Bank Unit Stake Sale

title: BlueBay RBC: Global Bond Market Selloff is 'Overdone'
summary: The global selloff in government bonds is "overdone" and a turn in the market is due, according to Mark Dowding, fixed income CIO at RBC BlueBay. Speaking on Bloomberg Television, he says the selloff was "not really justified" judging from data including inflation. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Philippines Starts Sale of Retail Bonds Amid Elevated Rates
